about: Starter P3 "Home on time" on the opening-es-otr-bonus brief (the owner's copy rating, 2026-11-12).

brief.subject: Conductor Clase A de larga distancia

recipe.name: Home on time
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with being home: the home time the brief states (every night, weekends, so many days a month), in the reader's words. If the brief states no home time, lead with the schedule or the area that keeps the driver near home. The one fact that makes it believable goes on the second line, in a few words.
recipe.image_prompt_template: Our truck parked on a quiet {street} at {time_of_day}, a porch light on, {season}, {viewpoint}, no people, no text, no logos, no lettering

en.primary_text: Dry van, over-the-road, coast to coast. You run 2 weeks, then you're home 3 days. $0.70 per mile and a $2,500 sign-on bonus. Class A, 23+.
en.headline: Class A OTR, dry van

es.primary_text: Carga seca en tráiler, rutas de costa a costa. Trabajas 2 semanas y luego pasas 3 días en casa. $0.70 por milla y bono de contratación de $2,500. Clase A, mayores de 23.
es.headline: Clase A, larga distancia

en.primary_text: Start with a $2,500 sign-on bonus. Then it's dry van, coast to coast, at $0.70 per mile, with 3 days home after every 2 weeks out. 401k included. Class A, age 23.
en.headline: $0.70/mile, dry van OTR

es.primary_text: Empiezas con un bono de contratación de $2,500. Carga seca de costa a costa a $0.70 por milla, con 3 días en casa cada 2 semanas en ruta. Incluye 401k. Clase A, mayor de 23 años.

en.primary_text: Here's the run: you pick up dry van loads and go coast to coast for 2 weeks. Then you're home 3 days. Pay is $0.70 per mile, and you get a 401k. Class A drivers, 23+.

es.primary_text: Así va la ruta: cargas en tráiler seco y vas de costa a costa por 2 semanas. Luego, 3 días en casa. Pagamos $0.70 por milla y tienes 401k. Choferes Clase A, mayores de 23.
